name: Holden Beach public restrooms
source: Town of Holden Beach Public Restroom Locations; Town of Holden Beach My Maps; Town ADA assessment (Oct 2025); NC DCM Beach & Waterfront Access; Brunswick County address points. Sites and merge decisions confirmed by Keith 2026-11-15. The former PW1 porta-john is gone and is not included. The OpenStreetMap toilet at The Point Parking Lot does not exist and is not included.

properties.name: East End Restrooms
properties.notes: ADA restrooms with emergency vehicle access, at the first beach access (PW1).
sources: Town ADA assessment (Oct 2025) 'Ave E / 339 OBE - Bathroom'

properties.name: Quinton Street Restrooms
properties.notes: Public restrooms at the Quinton Street lot (PW180), with an ADA ramp and parking.
sources: holdenbeachvisitors.com notes restrooms at the Quinton St lot. DCM PW180 says RESTRM=N (conflict)

properties.name: Block Q Restrooms
properties.notes: One marker for Block Q and the new Jordan Boulevard restrooms and stage pavilion, on the east side of Jordan Boulevard only. No separate west-side, under-the-bridge, or 131 Jordan Boulevard marker.
properties.coord_note: Moved to the west/southwest part of the Block Q lot toward Jordan Blvd (Keith, Nov 21, 2026), as on the printed map.

properties.name: Bridgeview Park Restrooms
properties.notes: Restrooms at Bridgeview Park (Rothschild and Davis Park).
sources: Town restroom list 'Rothschild and Davis Park'

properties.name: Pier Property Restrooms
properties.notes: Restrooms at the pier property are still open even though the pier itself is closed.
sources: holdenbeachvisitors.com (pier lot restrooms). Pier itself closed/condemned (Oct 2026).

properties.name: Porta-john, 792 Ocean Blvd West
properties.notes: Town address is 792 Ocean Blvd West (parking lot 792-788 OBW). 796 Ocean Blvd West is the town-owned house next door, not the porta-john address.
sources: Town of Holden Beach My Maps pin "792 OBW"
Town Parking Table May 2025 "792-788 Ocean Blvd W"

properties.name: Porta-john, Greensboro Street
properties.notes: At Greensboro Street and Ocean Blvd West, at the sewer lift station (per Keith).
sources: Town of Holden Beach My Maps
